source_kind: Offline postprocessing of completed physical trace; no new rollout

streaming_full_replay_identity.encoding: Concatenated little-endian float64: full post-step qpos then qvel per physical step; action per transition.

method.model: Strict original prepare; environment reset/step and mj_step patched to raise throughout
method.geometry: Independent MjData pre-state qpos/qvel/ctrl/time copied for every 1ms physical sample; mj_forward only; warmstart explicitly zero. Post-state snapshots independently recomputed.
method.force: Original trace retains total integration ground-force scalars, not per-body integration force vectors. Named body force/intervals here are independent pre-state recomputations, NOT the original integration forces; no equality is assumed.
method.intervals: Half-open intervals [pre_time,pre_time+1ms), sampled right count times1ms; no claim of continuous-time contact edges.
method.velocity: COM/subtree velocity and named body COM velocity reconstructed from exact saved qpos/qvel; world frame. Fixed3.5s foot-forward projection used to avoid changing-axis fall interpretation.
method.interval_encoding: Exact unsmoothed sample-index RLE [start inclusive,end exclusive]; recovery pre-state sample0 at elapsed0, nominaldt=.001s. Summary retains original accumulated MuJoCo boundary times. Unlisted wrist yaw/pitch bodies had no floor contact.
